youtube_full.title: The Years Given Back | Bedtime Scripture Story for Kids | Joel 2:21–28
youtube_full.description:
The Years Given Back: a bedtime scripture story for kids from Joel 2:21–28.

Joel’s land had a hard time. Huge crowds of locusts came, bugs like big grasshoppers.

Tonight's Scripture Traveler: Scout the Seeker.

Read along as the pages turn, then answer the bedtime questions together.

0:00 Opening the book
0:11 The story: The Years Given Back
1:12 Scripture Traveler of the Night: Scout the Seeker
1:50 A Feeling Moment and the Five Stones
3:00 Question time
3:18 Sweet dreams
3:36 More stories, the app and the paperback
